seed42_policy: Reuse the already completed Stage 3A formal OOF results; do not rerun.
training_protocol: Frozen Own-GNN v0 protocol; only the random seed varies between runs.

models.name: Own-GNN v0
models.representation: remove two valid dummy atoms and add marked endpoint-closure edge

models.name: Variant A — keep dummy atoms
models.representation: retain original dummy atoms and chemical bonds; no closure or endpoint marker

models.name: Variant B — endpoint marker, no closure
models.representation: remove two valid dummy atoms and mark their real neighbors; no closure edge

paired_runs: For every new seed, run all three models with the same seed, data, folds, metric, and frozen training settings.
analysis: Compute per-seed OOF wMAE and target MAE, paired deltas, five-seed means and standard deviations after all 12 new runs complete.
fold_seed_rule: Each run seed s sets fold initialization seeds s + fold_index (folds 0–4); all three models used the same run seed and therefore the same per-fold seeds.

cuda_smoke.purpose: seed-plumbing smoke only; excluded from model comparison

formal_execution.oof_validation: All 12 runs accepted by Stage 0 validator: 7,973 rows, no missing/extra/duplicate IDs.
formal_execution.nan_or_oom: None observed; run logs scanned for NaN, OOM, CUDA error, and traceback markers with zero hits.
formal_execution.startup_retry: The first Own-GNN v0 seed-43 launch was rejected by the clean-source guard because a temporary data symlink made the checkout dirty; it failed before epoch 1. The symlink was removed and the same frozen run completed using the external train CSV path. No model run was duplicated or overwritten.
